key_points: Co-CEO warns growth is too slow, flagging engagement concerns.
Stock trades around $67, roughly half its price a year ago, showing a sustained downtrend.
Expansion of ad-supported tier and WWE rights aims to add revenue but near‑term impact uncertain.
Analysts turn cautious on slowing engagement while noting potential upside from the Disney deal.
Insider purchase by Rep. Cleo Fields signals some underlying confidence amid weakness.
